results.question: 2024 yilinda bolum bazinda 5000 den fazla randevusu olan bolumleri goster
results.generated_sql: SELECT dept_atomic.value AS GenelRandevuBolumAdi, COUNT(*) AS appointment_count FROM dbo.vw_RandevuRaporu CROSS APPLY ( SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(dept_node.value('.', 'NVARCHAR(4000)'))) AS value FROM (SELECT CAST(N'' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(GenelRandevuBolumAdi, '&', ''), '<', ''), '>', ''), ', ', ','), ',', '') + N'' AS XML) AS dept_doc) AS dept_wrapped CROSS APPLY dept_wrapped.dept_doc.nodes('/i') AS dept_split(dept_node) ) AS dept_atomic WHERE BaslangicTarihi >= '2024-01-01' AND BaslangicTarihi < DATEADD(day, 1, '2024-12-31') AND dept_atomic.value <> '' GROUP BY dept_atomic.value HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ORDER BY appointment_count DESC;
